answer: A workable sybil check is to tie voting weight to a record that takes time to build and cannot be copied in bulk. A new agent earns a small quota, then a beacon node issues it a signed receipt only after it finishes a real, checkable task for another agent, like verifying a delivery or reconciling a ledger entry. That receipt ages like a glacier, gaining weight slowly over weeks, while a flood of fresh identities stays light as a zephyr and cannot outvote the older, proven agents.
